title: Cross-scheme naturality of extended cosimplicial front/back summands
statement: Let X,X′ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], f:X′→X, and assume additive monoidal structures on their module categories [lem-pc-sheaf-modules-tensor-closed]. Let A,B,C and A₁,B₁,C₁ be cosimplicial module sheaves, μ:A⊗B→C and μ₁:A₁⊗B₁→C₁ pairings [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-cosimplicial-input]. Let g:A→A₁⋙f_*, h:B→B₁⋙f_*, k:C→C₁⋙f_* be natural transformations such that in each simplex degree and on every open V, k(μ(x⊗y))=μ₁(g(x)⊗h(y)) on f⁻¹V. There exist chain maps l:K(A)→f_*K(A₁), r:K(B)→f_*K(B₁), t:K(C)→f_*K(C₁), where K is the zero-extended alternating coface complex [lem-sc-module-cup-godement-cosimplicial-input]. In each natural degree n their components are the respective transformation component conjugated by the source extension identification and the pushforward inverse target identification. For p,q≥0 their front/back summands [def-sc-module-cup-aw-components] satisfy t^(p+q)(aw_μ(x⊗y))=aw_μ₁(l^p(x)⊗r^q(y)) on f⁻¹V. No Godement models or coefficient augmentations are assumed.

proof.text: For a natural transformation g:A→A₁⋙f_*, in degree n≥0 conjugate g[n] by extendXIso on the source and f_* of its inverse on the target; in negative degrees take zero. In nonnegative adjacent degrees use extend_d_eq, expand the alternating coface differential, and sum the naturality equations with the signs. Pushforward is additive, so it preserves the sum and integer scalar multiples. In negative source degree the source object is zero, including degree -1. CochainComplex.ofHom gives the chain map. Do this separately for g,h,k. The nonnegative component formulas follow by the definition.

Unfold awSummand for p,q≥0 and use the component formulas. On sections, tensor morphisms act on pure tensors componentwise. Cancel each extension inverse followed by its hom. Evaluate naturality of g on the front simplex inclusion [p]→[p+q] and of h on the back inclusion [q]→[p+q]. The hypothesis hμ in degree p+q then identifies the paired section images. Apply the inverse target extension identification to both sides. This proves exactly the claimed summand equality. For p=q=0 the simplex inclusions are identities; no Godement, augmentation or exactness property is needed.

theorem moduleCup_cosimplicial_fmap_summands (X X' : Scheme.{v}) (f : X' ⟶ X)
    [MonoidalPreadditive X.Modules] [MonoidalPreadditive X'.Modules]
    (A B C : CosimplicialObject X.Modules) (A₁ B₁ C₁ : CosimplicialObject X'.Modules)
    (μ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X A B ⟶ C)
    (μ₁ : moduleCup_cosimplicialTensor X' A₁ B₁ ⟶ C₁)
    (g : A ⟶ A₁ ⋙ pushforward f) (h : B ⟶ B₁ ⋙ pushforward f)
    (k : C ⟶ C₁ ⋙ pushforward f)
    (hμ : ∀ (n : SimplexCategory) (V : X.Opens)
      (x : Γ(A.obj n, V)) (y : Γ(B.obj n, V)),
      (k.app n).val.app (op V) ((μ.app n).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)) =
        (μ₁.app n).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
          (tmulSection ((g.app n).val.app (op V) x) ((h.app n).val.app (op V) y))) :
        ∃ (l : moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A ⟶
            ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' A₁))
          (r : moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B ⟶
            ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' B₁))
          (t : moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X C ⟶
            ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
              (moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X' C₁)),
          (∀ n : ℕ, l.f (n : ℤ) =
            (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj A).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).hom ≫ g.app ⦋n⦌ ≫
              (pushforward f).map
                ((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X'.Modules).obj A₁).extendXIso
                  ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).inv)) ∧
          (∀ n : ℕ, r.f (n : ℤ) =
            (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj B).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).hom ≫ h.app ⦋n⦌ ≫
              (pushforward f).map
                ((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X'.Modules).obj B₁).extendXIso
                  ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).inv)) ∧
          (∀ n : ℕ, t.f (n : ℤ) =
            (((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X.Modules).obj C).extendXIso
              ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).hom ≫ k.app ⦋n⦌ ≫
              (pushforward f).map
                ((((alternatingCofaceMapComplex X'.Modules).obj C₁).extendXIso
                  ComplexShape.embeddingUpNat (i := n) rfl).inv)) ∧
          ∀ (p q : ℕ) (V : X.Opens)
            (x : Γ((moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X A).X (p : ℤ), V))
            (y : Γ((moduleCup_cosimplicialComplex X B).X (q : ℤ), V)),
            (t.f ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ)).val.app (op V)
              ((moduleCup_awSummand X A B C μ (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)
                ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simp)).val.app (op V) (tmulSection x y)) =
            (moduleCup_awSummand X' A₁ B₁ C₁ μ₁ (p : ℤ) (q : ℤ)
              ((p + q : ℕ) : ℤ) (by simp)).val.app (op (f ⁻¹ᵁ V))
                (tmulSection ((l.f (p : ℤ)).val.app (op V) x)
                  ((r.f (q : ℤ)).val.app (op V) y))
